# directus_collection (Data Source)

Reads a Directus collection by name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `collection` (String) Name of the collection to look up.

### Read-Only

- `meta` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--meta))
- `schema` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schema))

<a id="nestedatt--meta"></a>
### Nested Schema for `meta`

Read-Only:

- `collapse` (String) Default collapse behavior.
- `color` (String) Accent color.
- `display_template` (String) Display template.
- `group` (String) Parent collection.
- `hidden` (Boolean) Hidden in the app.
- `icon` (String) Material icon name.
- `note` (String) Description.
- `singleton` (Boolean) Singleton collection.
- `sort_field` (String) Manual sort field.


<a id="nestedatt--schema"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schema`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Table comment.
- `name` (String) Table name.
- `schema` (String) Database schema.
